caption: The drawing depicts a single large ceramic jug rendered in shades of brown with subtle variations, giving it a textured, stoneware appearance. The jug has a narrow neck with a small opening at the top and broadens out towards the base, creating a rounded, voluminous body. Near the upper center of the jug, the text "JULIUS NORTON" is inscribed in blue. Below the inscription, there is an illustration of a blue butterfly with outstretched wings, slightly off-center. Some pale stains and marks are visible on the surface, suggesting age or use. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset illustration of the same jug, shown with a handle on the neck, suggesting another view or version of the object. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the main jug is centered within a rectangular border. The artist's signature, "N. Amantea," is visible in the lower right-hand corner of the main rectangle.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
